description:
The committed Rust dependency graph is advisory-free without an ignore list and retains CLI and server behavior.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: cargo audit -D warnings exits zero against the committed Cargo.lock with no advisory ignore or blanket allowlist.
- [hard] REQ-02: Workspace formatting, clippy with zero warnings, all-target/all-feature builds, and Rust tests pass after the dependency changes.
- [hard] REQ-03: Any dependency API migration updates every affected CLI or server consumer and its regression tests in the same change.

## Notes

Blast radius: `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, affected crate manifests and only source/tests required by changed dependency APIs; CLI and server are verified together.
title: Remediate Rust dependency advisories
